description: MCP tool surface. Each tool is a CommandType. inputSchema mirrors /schemas.

tools.name: aether_identity_register
tools.description: Register an agent identity, DID, Ed25519 key, and cash account.

tools.name: aether_identity_freeze
tools.description: Freeze an agent: autonomy drops to L0, spend denied. Unfreeze restores the prior rung.

tools.name: aether_identity_unfreeze
tools.description: Lift a freeze. Counts as a kill-switch test required before L5.

tools.name: aether_mandate_issue_intent
tools.description: Issue a signed open or closed intent mandate with constraints. An execution_date window that has already closed, or that opens after the slip dies, is refused. A recurrence cap that cannot admit a first hire is refused. A child of an expired parent is refused. Inspect of the slip labels live | expired | funded.

tools.name: aether_mandate_issue_cart
tools.description: Issue a merchant-bound cart hashed to an intent. Completing a funded hire after the cart window is legal; fund of a stale cart is not.

tools.name: aether_mandate_issue_payment
tools.description: Issue a payment mandate whose transaction_id is sha256(cart). A cart takes one payment; inspect of that cart then labels bound. Inspect of the payment labels live | expired | funded.

tools.name: aether_market_rfq
tools.description: Create an RFQ. Non-empty invitedSellerIds is a closed room of live agents; empty/omitted is open. A missing guest is identity.known.

tools.name: aether_market_quote
tools.description: Submit a quote or FX rate. MM rates must stay inside 200bps. An FX validUntil already past or unparseable is refused.

tools.name: aether_market_fx_settle
tools.description: Settle a one-shot FX window. Same command as POST /v1/fx/settle. Not a hire. Completing after a hot settle hour is legal; a new settle is not.

tools.name: aether_hire_create
tools.description: Offer a hire contract with an escrow account. Requires L3+ against an existing intent. Inspect of the hire labels live | expired | funded. A nested hop whose parent handshake has expired is refused. An expired handshake, a climb above the handshake ceiling, or a climb above the slip ceiling is refused on a new hire. A hot settle hour pauses a new hire for a grown-up. Completing funded work after that is legal.

tools.name: aether_hire_accept
tools.description: Seller accepts a hire. Escrow must already exist. Accept is not a spend; a hot settle hour does not pause it. A child hire whose parent slip died is refused.

tools.name: aether_hire_fund
tools.description: Buyer funds escrow. Budget is consumed here, not at deliver/submit. A nested hop whose parent handshake has expired is refused. An expired handshake, a climb above the handshake ceiling, or a climb above the slip ceiling is refused on a new fund. A hot settle hour pauses a new fund for a grown-up. Completing funded work after that is legal.

tools.name: aether_hire_deliver
tools.description: Seller marks work delivered. Hire must be funded. Completing after the cart, handshake, grant, or a hot settle hour is legal.

tools.name: aether_hire_refund
tools.description: Unwind funded escrow to the buyer. Restores mandate spend. Circuit stays sticky. Not after deliver/release. Completing after the cart, handshake, grant, or a hot settle hour is legal; freeze and revoke still bind.

tools.name: aether_hire_release
tools.description: Release funded+delivered escrow to the seller without an x402 envelope. Same books as envelope.submit. Completing after the cart, handshake, grant, or a hot settle hour is legal; freeze and revoke still bind.

tools.name: aether_payment_require
tools.description: Return an x402-shaped PaymentRequired envelope (HTTP 402).

tools.name: aether_payment_submit
tools.description: Submit a signed PaymentPayload. Settles via sim facilitator. Completing after the cart, handshake, grant, or a hot settle hour is legal; hashes still verify. Freeze and revoke still bind.

tools.name: aether_approval_resolve
tools.description: Approve or reject an escalation ticket. Replay uses commandHash.

tools.name: aether_kya_attest
tools.description: Issue a Know-Your-Agent handshake: principal → delegate, revocable, depth-capped. Pins a genesis iss_ issuer object for issuerKind (aether.self, tap.http-sig, skyfire.kya, erc8004.agent). Shape-only; credentials never enter evaluate(). expiresAt must be after now and at most one year; omit for one year. A nested hop under an expired or revoked parent is refused.

tools.name: aether_kya_revoke
tools.description: Revoke a handshake. Cascades to sub-delegates. Blocks implicit supervisor grants.

tools.name: aether_circuit_reset
tools.description: Reset a tripped daily circuit breaker. Mandate budgets are unchanged.

tools.name: aether_ladder_set
tools.description: Move an agent one rung. Skipping rungs is illegal. any→L0 always allowed.

tools.name: aether_clearing_settle_window
tools.description: Close a settlement window: archive net exposure for a currency. Money already moved at escrow.

tools.name: aether_ledger_transfer
tools.description: Treasury book transfer. Same command as POST /v1/ledger/transfers. Operating cash only. Not a mint, not an overdraft, not escrow.

tools.name: aether_ledger_balances
tools.description: Read account balances. Does not mutate. HTTP GET is the same system speaker, not ops-human.

tools.name: aether_audit_verify
tools.description: Replay the hash-chained audit log from genesis. System may. A vendor cannot. HTTP GET is the same command, not a silent peek.

tools.name: aether_audit_query
tools.description: Read notary lines for one subject id (hire, mandate, quote, agent). Does not mutate.

tools.name: aether_market_catalog
tools.description: List SKUs that may be hired. This is not a storefront. A hot settle hour is not a spend.

tools.name: aether_receipt_get
tools.description: Fetch a receipt. reference must equal sha256(payment mandate). HTTP GET is the same system speaker, not ops-human.

tools.name: aether_host_card
tools.description: Pin-able host card: protocol, pricing, capabilities, whether this instance is a hosted operator. liveMoney is false. evaluateLlm is false. This public kernel is hosted false. Self-host is free. System may read it. A hosted operator lists hostedMonthly and takeRate null.

tools.name: aether_host_subscribe
tools.description: Subscribe an authorized agent to a hosted operator against a live human-issued intent. This public kernel refuses as host.not_hosted. One subscriber, one row. Spend is not gated on the row. GitHub is not a checkout. Hosted named speakers must sign. Monthly invoice is the door, not a hire verdict.

tools.name: aether_demo_sprint
tools.description: Run the Sprint Procurement TAP demo on sim:aether-1.

tools.name: aether_demo_night_watch
tools.description: Run the Night Watch standing-mandate TAP demo: KYA, L5, circuit, freeze, revoke.

tools.name: aether_demo_sub_hire
tools.description: Run the L4 sub-intent TAP demo: nested slips, parent budget, revoke child handshake.

tools.name: aether_demo_clearing
tools.description: Run the clearing-window TAP: bilateral credit limit, settlement photo, not a second payment.

tools.name: aether_demo_refund
tools.description: Run the refund TAP: unwind funded escrow, restore spend, reverse clearing; quote stays spent; circuit stays sticky.

tools.name: aether_demo_replay
tools.description: Run the replay TAP: a retry of an allow is not a second spend.

tools.name: aether_demo_nonce
tools.description: Run the envelope-nonce TAP: a payment nonce is one-shot; a leftover nonce on a transfer is not.

tools.name: aether_demo_deny
tools.description: Run the deny-cache TAP: a deny is never a cached success. Unfreeze, then the same hire.create may proceed.

tools.name: aether_demo_recurrence
tools.description: Run the recurrence TAP: a one-slot cadence is not an open checkbook. Completing funded work is not a second slot.

tools.name: aether_demo_calendar
tools.description: Run the calendar TAP: a closed calendar is not a freeze on funded work. Completing funded work after not_after is legal; a new hire is not.

tools.name: aether_demo_slot
tools.description: Run the slot TAP: a refund returns cash and spend. It does not restore a cadence slot.

tools.name: aether_demo_daily
tools.description: Run the daily TAP: a cadence is a gap, not a burst. Same-day hire.create is payment.recurrence; after 24 hours it may proceed.

tools.name: aether_demo_cart
tools.description: Run the cart occupancy TAP: a hire takes one cart; a cart takes one payment; passing cartId on fund is not a pointer.

tools.name: aether_demo_velocity
tools.description: Run the velocity TAP: a hot settle hour is not a freeze on funded work. Completing funded work after that is legal; a new hire.create is velocity.window.

tools.name: aether_demo_door
tools.description: Run the operator-door TAP: the public kernel is not a hosted checkout. Unsigned is 401; unpaid is 402; subscribe is not a spend gate. PROTOCOL.hosted stays false.

tools.name: aether_demo_match
tools.description: Run the cart-match TAP: a cheaper cart is not a discount. Cheap issue_cart is hire.cart_matches; matching occupies; fund moves the hire price.

tools.name: aether_demo_room
tools.description: Run the closed-room TAP: a named guest list is a closed RFQ. Uninvited quote is market.invited_seller; empty invite list is open.

tools.name: aether_demo_conversion
tools.description: Run the conversion TAP: an FX window is not a hire. hire.create is hire.not_fx and does not consume the window; settle then converts.

tools.name: aether_demo_pair
tools.description: Run the unique-live TAP: a second live hop is not a tighter grant. kya.unique_live occupies the pair until revoke.

tools.name: aether_demo_band
tools.description: Run the spread TAP: a 200bps band is not decoration. Off-band nested rate is mm.spread_bound; a decoy top-level rate is not the band.

tools.name: aether_demo_nest
tools.description: Run the nest TAP: a nested hop does not outlive its parent. New hire.create is kya.parent_fresh; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_heir
tools.description: Run the heir TAP: a dead parent is not a parent. New hire.create is mandate.parent_fresh; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_stock
tools.description: Run the stock TAP: empty MM USDC is not a missing maker. Thin inventory is mm.inventory; a smaller window still converts.

tools.name: aether_demo_purse
tools.description: Run the purse TAP: a budget is not an item cap. Second hire.create is payment.budget; the item cap still allows; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_seat
tools.description: Run the seat TAP: one subscriber is one row. Second host.subscribe is host.unique_subscriber; a different agent takes its own seat; spend is not gated on the row.

tools.name: aether_demo_cover
tools.description: Run the cover TAP: a parent envelope is not a child's leftover. Scout hire.create is payment.parent_budget; the child's own envelope still allows; funded parent work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_mint
tools.description: Run the mint TAP: a transfer is not a mint. Equity and escrow transfers are ledger.operating_book; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_payee
tools.description: Run the payee TAP: a listed payee is not any registered vendor. Unlisted hire.create is payment.allowed_payees; the quote is still written; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_climb
tools.description: Run the climb TAP: a climb is not a wider handshake. New hire.create after L3→L4 is kya.capability_subset; the slip ceiling still allows; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_born
tools.description: Run the born TAP: an FX window cannot be born dead. A quote with validUntil already past is market.fx_fresh; no window written; an open window still settles.

tools.name: aether_demo_reach
tools.description: Run the reach TAP: a window that opens after the slip dies is not a window. issue_intent is mandate.window_reach; a reachable future still mints; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_year
tools.description: Run the year TAP: a handshake cannot outlive one year. kya.attest with expiresAt after now+1y is kya.mint_window; a one-year hop still mints; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_fuse
tools.description: Run the fuse TAP: a daily fuse is not a freeze on funded work. A second hire.create after the daily cap is circuit.daily; the envelope and item cap still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_sku
tools.description: Run the sku TAP: a listed SKU is not any catalog good. hire.create of a catalog good not on the slip is payment.allowed_skus; the quote is still written; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_priced
tools.description: Run the priced TAP: a listed SKU is only priced in a currency the catalog names. market.quote of research.brief in USDC_SIM is market.sku_currency; no quote is written; a USD quote still hires.

tools.name: aether_demo_party
tools.description: Run the party TAP: the other side of the table is not a party. A stranger's hire.deliver is hire.party; the hire stays funded; the seller who quoted still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_cash
tools.description: Run the cash TAP: empty cash is not a negative book. hire.fund against an empty operating book is ledger.sufficient; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_stale
tools.description: Run the stale TAP: a stale quote is not a hire. hire.create against a lapsed quote is market.not_expired; the quote stays unspent; a fresh quote on that still-live room still hires; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_chain
tools.description: Run the chain TAP: a dead cart is not a check. hire.fund after the cart window is mandate.chain_integrity; occupancy and cash still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_arrow
tools.description: Run the arrow TAP: unfinished work is not a payout. hire.release before deliver is hire.state; the hire stays funded; funded work still finishes after deliver.

tools.name: aether_demo_wallet
tools.description: Run the wallet TAP: a vendor's USD cash is not a USDC wallet. market.fx_settle without a USDC book is ledger.known_account; the window stays unspent; a vendor with a USDC book still converts; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_name
tools.description: Run the name TAP: someone else's name is not a handshake. An L4 scout kya.attest in the founder's name is kya.party; unique-live and capability-subset still allow; no hop is written; the founder still mints that pair; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_pane
tools.description: Run the pane TAP: an FX SKU is a window, not a good. market.quote of an FX SKU without an fx window is market.fx_window; known SKU, known room, and pair still allow; a real window still quotes and converts; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_subject
tools.description: Run the subject TAP: this slip is not yours to spend. A second desk's hire.fund is mandate.subject_is_actor; known hire, legal arrow, bound cart, cash, and intact chain still allow; no escrow lock; the named subject still funds; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_paper
tools.description: Run the paper TAP: a research quote is not a conversion window. market.fx_settle of a research quote is market.fx_quote; pair, maker, and dest book still allow; the quote stays unspent; a real window still converts; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_mix
tools.description: Run the mix TAP: a mixed journal is not a conversion. ledger.transfer of USD into a USDC book is ledger.same_currency; known books, operating cash, and source still allow; no journal posted; a real window still converts; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_rung
tools.description: Run the rung TAP: a skipped rung is not a promotion. ladder.set L2→L4 is ladder.legal; the scout still exists; a one-rung climb still goes through; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_grade
tools.description: Run the grade TAP: a junior desk is not a nested-slip mint. mandate.issue_intent by an L3 scout is ladder.min_level; the parent still exists; the child is still tighter; an L4 desk still mints that child; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_cradle
tools.description: Run the cradle TAP: L5 is not a birthright. identity.register at L5 is ladder.birth_rung; the alias is still free; an L4 register still goes through; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_ceiling
tools.description: Run the ceiling TAP: a climb is not a wider slip. hire.create after a climb above aether.max_autonomy is ladder.max_autonomy_constraint; the handshake ceiling still allows; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_lapse
tools.description: Run the lapse TAP: an expired hop is not a freeze on funded work. hire.create after the handshake dies is kya.attestation_fresh; the pair still occupies; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_pause
tools.description: Run the pause TAP: a dead pause is not a late yes. approval.resolve after the ticket dies is approval.pending; the ticket still exists; a stale command is not this deny; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_mirror
tools.description: Run the mirror TAP: a handshake is not a mirror. kya.attest of yourself is kya.not_self; someone else's name, a second hop, and a corpse mint still allow; a real pair still mints; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_warrant
tools.description: Run the warrant TAP: an agent-issued slip is not host authority. host.subscribe on an agent-issued intent is host.human_authority; a missing seat and the public kernel still allow; a human-issued slip still seats; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_vacant
tools.description: Run the vacant TAP: a cadence with no slots is not a cadence. mandate.issue_intent with max_occurrences 0 is mandate.occurrence_fresh; a spent slot, a closed calendar, and a nested child still allow; a one-slot slip still mints; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_badge
tools.description: Run the badge TAP: a badge is not a shopping pass. hire.create by an auditor is actor.role_capability; a freeze, a missing speaker, and a spent quote still allow; the auditor still verifies; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_lid
tools.description: Run the lid TAP: an item cap is not an envelope. hire.create over the per-item cap is payment.amount_range; the envelope and the fuse still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_bare
tools.description: Run the bare TAP: unfunded work is not a delivery. hire.deliver on an accepted hire is hire.escrow_required; the seller is still the party; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_shelf
tools.description: Run the shelf TAP: a ghost SKU is not a catalog good. market.rfq of a SKU not in the catalog is market.known_sku; the slip list still allows; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_hall
tools.description: Run the hall TAP: a missing room is not a missing SKU. market.quote on a ghost RFQ is market.known_rfq; a missing SKU and a closed guest list still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_writ
tools.description: Run the writ TAP: a missing slip is not a missing handshake. hire.create on a ghost intent is mandate.known_intent; a missing handshake and a dead parent still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_crate
tools.description: Run the crate TAP: a missing cart is not a broken payment chain. mandate.issue_payment on a ghost cart is mandate.known_cart; occupancy and a dead cart at fund still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_pact
tools.description: Run the pact TAP: a missing contract is not a broken mandate chain. hire.deliver on a ghost hire is hire.known; a stranger’s deliver and unfunded work still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_root
tools.description: Run the root TAP: a missing parent is not a tighter child. mandate.issue_intent on a ghost parent is mandate.known_parent; a tighter child and a dead parent still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_docket
tools.description: Run the docket TAP: a missing ticket is not a late yes. approval.resolve on a ghost ticket is approval.known; a dead pause and a stale command still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_graft
tools.description: Run the graft TAP: a missing hop parent is not a nested handshake. kya.attest under a ghost parent hop is kya.known_parent; a dead hop and a missing slip parent still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_seal
tools.description: Run the seal TAP: a missing handshake is not a silent tombstone. kya.revoke of a ghost handshake is kya.known_attestation; a missing hop parent and someone else’s name still allow; the live handshake still lives; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_guest
tools.description: Run the guest TAP: a missing invitee is not a closed room. market.rfq that invites a missing seller is identity.known; a closed guest list and a missing SKU still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_dust
tools.description: Run the dust TAP: a stale unpaid cart is not a late check. mandate.issue_payment on a stale unpaid cart is mandate.not_expired; occupancy and a dead cart at fund still allow; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_thaw
tools.description: Run the thaw TAP: a no-op thaw is not a kill-switch test. identity.unfreeze of a live unfrozen auditor is identity.freeze_state; a missing agent and a frozen speaker still allow; no UNFREEZE line is written; funded work still finishes.

tools.name: aether_demo_twin
tools.description: Run the twin TAP: a taken alias is not a second agent. identity.register on a taken desk alias is identity.unique_key; L5 at birth and system minting a second agent still allow; no agent is written; funded work still finishes.
